enonce_intro_markdown:
**SECTION D: ESSAY WRITING (10 MARKS)**

Write an essay of between 250-300 words on any ONE of the following topics.

questions.enonce_markdown:
1) Imagine that you were sent to your village by your Principal to attend a cultural festival organised in honour of the chief of the village. While in the village you were interested in the different activities that were being done. Write an article that will be published in your school magazine clearly showing:
- the different preparations made,
- the importance of this event to the people and the community,
- what you think could be done to ameliorate the things that were not well done.

Your name is Mbinta Udu. The name of the school is GBHS Nsuakka, Korea.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un article destiné à un journal scolaire suit une structure précise : un titre accrocheur, une courte introduction qui situe l'événement (qui, quoi, où, quand), un développement qui traite dans l'ordre chaque point exigé par la consigne - de préférence en paragraphes distincts - et une conclusion qui résume l'intérêt de l'événement. Le nombre de mots imposé (ici 250 à 300) doit être respecté, et les trois points demandés par la consigne doivent tous apparaître clairement.

Modèle de corrigé (article complet, environ 270 mots) :

**CULTURAL FESTIVAL BRINGS NSUAKKA TOGETHER**

*By Mbinta Udu, GBHS Nsuakka, Korea*

Last month, I was sent by our Principal to attend the cultural festival organised in honour of the chief of my village. The event, which brought together hundreds of people from different corners of the region, left me with lasting impressions that I would like to share with the readers of our school magazine.

Preparations for the festival started weeks in advance. The compound of the palace was swept and decorated with palm fronds and colourful cloths. Young men repaired the paths leading to the village square while women prepared traditional dishes such as achu and njama-njama for the guests. Musicians and dancers rehearsed every evening, and the elders of the village met several times to plan the order of ceremonies.

The festival proved to be much more than mere entertainment. It reminded the younger generation, myself included, of the customs and values that hold the community together: respect for elders, solidarity, and pride in our cultural heritage. Traders also benefited greatly, as many visitors bought local craft and food, boosting the village economy for several days.

However, not everything went as smoothly as expected. The public address system broke down twice during the traditional dances, and there were not enough seats for elderly guests, who had to stand for long hours. In future editions, the organising committee should test all equipment beforehand and provide adequate seating for everyone, especially the aged.

Overall, the festival was a wonderful opportunity for the community to celebrate its identity, and with a few improvements, it can become an even greater success in the years to come.

Cet article respecte les trois exigences de la consigne dans trois paragraphes séparés (préparatifs, importance de l'événement, améliorations à apporter), s'ouvre par un titre et une signature conformes au format journalistique, et reste dans la fourchette imposée de 250 à 300 mots.

### Piège à éviter
Ne pas traiter l'un des trois points imposés par la consigne (les préparatifs, l'importance de l'événement, les améliorations à apporter) fait perdre des points même si l'article est par ailleurs bien écrit : la structure imposée compte autant que la qualité de la langue.

### Conseil
Rédige d'abord un plan avec les trois points exigés avant de commencer à écrire : cela évite d'en oublier un une fois lancé dans la rédaction, et permet de répartir équitablement les 250 à 300 mots entre les parties.

questions.enonce_markdown: 2) Educational opportunities are meant for boys and girls but this is not the case in some societies. In some African societies, most of the female children are confined in the homes and others forced into early marriages. You are from a polygamous home where there are more girls than boys. What do you think could be done by the authorities to ameliorate the standards of these girls who have been held down by the caprices of tradition and culture?
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un essai argumentatif en anglais suit un plan explicite : une introduction qui reformule le sujet et annonce la position défendue, un développement organisé en paragraphes qui présentent chacun un argument distinct appuyé par une explication ou un exemple, et une conclusion qui résume la position et, si possible, l'élargit. Chaque paragraphe doit commencer par une idée clairement énoncée, jamais un mélange de plusieurs arguments dans le même paragraphe. Le nombre de mots imposé doit être respecté.

Modèle de corrigé (essai complet, environ 270 mots) :

Educational opportunities are, in theory, open to every child regardless of sex. In practice, however, many African societies still confine girls to the home while boys are sent to school. This is particularly common in polygamous families, where a large number of children compete for limited resources and girls are often the first to be sacrificed. Coming from such a background myself, with more girls than boys in my family, I believe that concrete measures must be taken by the authorities to change this situation.

First, the government should reinforce the existing laws that make primary and secondary education compulsory for every child, and ensure that offending parents who withdraw their daughters from school face real sanctions, not just warnings on paper. Local education officials should carry out regular follow-up visits in villages to identify girls who have dropped out and encourage their parents to send them back to school.

Second, financial support such as scholarships, free school kits and reduced school fees should be extended specifically to girls from large or polygamous families, since poverty is often the main reason parents prefer to invest in their sons. Community sensitisation campaigns, led by chiefs and religious leaders who are respected in these societies, would also help change the belief that a girl's place is only in the kitchen or in an early marriage.

Finally, successful women from similar backgrounds should be invited to schools to serve as role models, showing girls and their parents that education, not early marriage, is the surest path out of poverty.

If these measures are combined, tradition and culture will no longer stand in the way of a girl's right to learn, and families like mine will finally see their daughters given the same chances as their sons.

Cet essai respecte le plan attendu : une introduction qui pose le problème et annonce une prise de position, trois paragraphes d'arguments ("First", "Second", "Finally") clairement distincts, et une conclusion qui résume l'ensemble.

### Piège à éviter
Se contenter de décrire le problème sans jamais répondre concrètement à la question posée ("What do you think could be done...") fait perdre l'essentiel des points : la consigne attend des propositions précises, pas seulement un constat.

### Conseil
Numérote mentalement tes arguments (First, Second, Finally) avant de rédiger : cela structure visuellement l'essai et aide le correcteur à suivre ton raisonnement du premier au dernier paragraphe.

questions.enonce_markdown: 3) Students are becoming more and more stubborn. They disrespect their parents, teachers and even the school administration. Many people attribute this to their home training. Do you agree?
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un essai argumentatif en anglais suit un plan explicite : une introduction qui reformule le sujet et annonce la position défendue, un développement organisé en paragraphes qui présentent chacun un argument distinct appuyé par une explication ou un exemple, et une conclusion qui résume la position et, si possible, l'élargit. Chaque paragraphe doit commencer par une idée clairement énoncée, jamais un mélange de plusieurs arguments dans le même paragraphe. Le nombre de mots imposé doit être respecté.

Modèle de corrigé (essai complet, environ 270 mots) :

In recent years, complaints about the bad behaviour of students have multiplied: many are said to disrespect their parents, their teachers and even the school administration. Some observers blame this entirely on home training. I agree that the family bears a large share of responsibility, although it is not the only factor at play.

To begin with, the home is the first school of every child. Parents who fail to correct bad behaviour early, who are too busy to supervise their children, or who themselves disrespect authority in front of their children, raise sons and daughters who copy the same attitudes at school. A child who is never punished for answering back at home will naturally answer back to a teacher who corrects him.

However, home training alone cannot explain the whole problem. The influence of social media and foreign films, which often glorify rebellion and disrespect for authority, reaches children whether or not their parents approve of it. Peer pressure at school also pushes some students to imitate the boldest, most disrespectful classmates in order to be accepted by the group. Furthermore, some teachers and administrators no longer command the same authority as before, partly because certain forms of punishment have been banned without being replaced by equally effective methods.

In conclusion, while poor home training is indeed a major cause of the growing stubbornness observed among students, it works together with the negative influence of the media, peer pressure and a weakened school discipline system. Real improvement will only come when parents, teachers and the community act together, rather than blaming the family alone.

Cet essai prend clairement position ("I agree... although it is not the only factor"), développe l'argument attendu par la consigne (le rôle de l'éducation familiale) puis le nuance avec d'autres causes, et conclut en réaffirmant une position mesurée plutôt qu'un simple oui ou non.

### Piège à éviter
Répondre uniquement par "yes" ou "no" sans jamais nuancer, ou au contraire rester vague sans jamais prendre position claire, sont les deux excès à éviter : la consigne ("Do you agree?") attend une position argumentée, éventuellement nuancée, mais clairement assumée du début à la fin de l'essai.
